Projects

Things I've built

Filter by what you're into. The four flagships are first; the rest of the public work is listed under them with GitHub links.

FlagshipPythonVoice AI

Lisa — Windows Voice Assistant

A friendly, local-first desktop assistant that wakes on “Hey Lisa”. Grok-powered brain, offline voice, local memory, an allow-list of apps only, and a second confirmation before anything destructive. v1.1 added live coding help: Lisa opens projects in VS Code / Antigravity, reads and edits files inside one safe workspace (with .bak backups), and the changes appear live in the editor.

GitHub repo ↗
Chrome ExtensionReact · TS

Teddy AI — Browser Assistant

An MV3 Chrome extension with Groq and Meta AI providers: page summarising from the real tab, Ctrl+K command palette, screenshot & ask, writing help on any selection, tab grouping, study flashcards and a local memory & privacy dashboard. Your keys stay in Settings — never in chat.

GitHub profile ↗
React · VitePostgreSQL · Prisma

Teacher Performance & Task Dashboard

Full-stack dashboard for tracking teacher performance and assigned tasks — React/Vite frontend over a PostgreSQL database modelled with Prisma. Built as a real, runnable app with a clean separation between UI, API and data.

GitHub repo ↗
MongoDBAdvanced DBMS

E-commerce Payment Database

My slice of a six-member Advanced DBMS project: a complete MongoDB payment database — users, orders, payment methods, payments, transactions, refunds, invoices, coupons, settlements and fraud checks — seeded with realistic, internally-consistent Indian e-commerce data in plain .js scripts.

GitHub profile ↗

Mega SMP Log Bot + VIBEY SMP

A custom Discord bot that tails Minecraft server logs and posts joins, leaves, deaths and key events into a private mods-only channel — built to help moderate the S.R.E Gaming Community's Mega SMP. Alongside it, my own VIBEY SMP server and the MrVibey Community Discord.
